    "name": "sidhantunnithan"

      "options": [
        "simple",
        "granular"
      ],
      "default": "simple"
    },
    "showModel": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show model",
      "description": "The main loop's model, as /model shows it.",

    },
    "showCwd": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show directory",
      "description": "The session's working directory, home as ~.",

    },
    "showBar": {

    "showFiveHour": {
